english_waiver.value: Yes: waived if degree taught entirely in English (documentation required); Nigeria not automatically listed
english_waiver.quote: holding degrees where English is the only language of instruction for the entirety of the program

toefl.value: Recommended 4.5 on new scale (page); COE generic 79 iBT

application_fee.value: USD 100 normally; waived for new master's applicants for Fall 2026 and Spring 2027 terms (Fall 2027 waiver not confirmed; one search snippet said Fall 2027 waived, unverified)

work_experience_considered.value: Recent professional resume with detailed responsibilities required; experience valued (software roles)

bachelor_field.value: Standard MS CS aimed at software engineers/CS professionals; Align MS CS for any discipline
bachelor_field.quote: Align track exists for non-majors ... bachelor's in any discipline

non_cs_notes.value: Standard program page lists no explicit CS-degree requirement but targets 'software engineer, software development engineer, related computer science professional, or recent CS graduate'; Align track for non-CS (as little as 2.5 years).

experience_pathway.value: UNKNOWN for standard track; Align track for non-CS

other_requirements.value: 2 recommendation letters, SOP with career goals, resume, transcripts + FCE

deadline.value: Fall and Spring international June 1 per graduate page; Vancouver page: June 15 / Nov 1 - conflict

ministry_consent.value: Yes: written consent of the Minister effective May 9, 2024
ministry_consent.quote: This program is offered under the written consent of the Minister effective May 9, 2024

curriculum_focus.value: Core algorithms and programming design; breadth in systems & software, theory & security, AI & data science; electives incl. systems/security

eligibility_notes: Provisional: CS-oriented (algorithms core, theory breadth), weaker relevance than IS programs; non-CS applicant would likely need the Align variant (longer, ~2.5 years, cost higher). Not rejected for background due to Align pathway. Co-op available, intl tuition ~CAD 51.8k.
